stories.title: Police deployed during stand-off over control of Poland's top court
stories.summary: Police were deployed outside Poland's Constitutional Tribunal as a stand-off over control of the top court escalated, after the government suspended two senior justices and moved to bring criminal charges against them. The long-running dispute over judicial appointments has effectively paralyzed the institution.

stories.title: Turkey throws former foreign minister's name into race for next UN chief
stories.summary: Turkey officially nominated Feridun Sinirlioglu, a former foreign minister and UN ambassador who now leads the OSCE, to succeed Antonio Guterres as UN secretary-general. He joins a crowded field as the Security Council struggles to rally behind a frontrunner.

stories.title: Polish president turns back from Senegal trip as top court chief suspended
stories.summary: Polish President Karol Nawrocki turned his plane around en route to Senegal and returned to Warsaw after the Constitutional Tribunal's president was suspended, deepening a long-running dispute that has paralyzed the court.

stories.title: SEC's top cop says agency is monitoring AI corporate disclosures
stories.summary: SEC enforcement director David Woodcock said the agency is monitoring how companies disclose AI-related risks, signaling scrutiny of whether issuers are giving investors the full picture without standing in the way of innovation.

stories.title: Baseten to raise funding that would double value to $30 billion
stories.summary: AI infrastructure startup Baseten is set to raise new funding that would double its valuation to $30 billion, extending a surge in investor appetite for the compute that AI models run on.

stories.title: Ohio State makes logical QB call ahead of USC showdown
stories.summary: With Julian Sayin out indefinitely with a throwing-arm injury, Ohio State is expected to start true freshman Luke Fahey at quarterback for Saturday night's game at USC.

stories.title: Leclerc tops eventful FP2 from Norris and Russell in Mexico City
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc set the pace in both Friday practice sessions at the Mexico City Grand Prix, edging Lando Norris and George Russell in FP2 as Ferrari led the way ahead of qualifying.

stories.title: 1 dead, 2 injured in west Columbus shooting
stories.summary: One person died and two were injured in a shooting Friday night in Columbus' Briggsdale neighborhood, police said, with officers responding to a reported shooting and an investigation underway.
